THE ECHO BELOW · SCENE
18 · Glasstaff’s quarters · area 12
Change prepared scene
Say aloud

A better-appointed room sits beyond the rougher hideout. Papers lie beside a travel chest. Someone has been planning from here.

The desk and chest suggest different sorts of business: work done in the open and possessions kept close. You can examine what is visible, listen toward the adjoining spaces, or check the way you came. Nothing here tells you what happened after someone left without further evidence.

Ask the players

Where did the party last see Glasstaff? What remains to search, and how is Gundren doing at the inn?
